question: Does the official ICFA 2024 proceedings archive expose the full Maragondon Estuary Mugil cephalus microplastics paper announced by CvSU?

sourceReviews.title: Cancel presents paper at 11th International Conference on Fisheries and Aquaculture 2024
sourceReviews.finding: The official September 2024 CvSU newsletter names the presentation title, Mugil cephalus, and Maragondon Estuary, and summarizes microplastics in scales, gills, and guts. It provides no sample count, collection date, station, coordinates, fish-identification method, vouchers, or per-fish occurrence table.

sourceReviews.title: Proceedings of the 11th International Conference on Fisheries and Aquaculture, Vol. 11 No. 1 (2024)
sourceReviews.finding: The publisher's issue page lists three papers: a Nile tilapia feeding trial, a Pangasius/Piaractus probiotic study, and a Sri Lankan Saccostrea microplastics paper. It does not list the CvSU Maragondon Estuary title. This only establishes non-listing in the reviewed issue contents, not that the paper was never presented or published elsewhere.

sourceReviews.title: About the Proceedings of the International Conference on Fisheries and Aquaculture
sourceReviews.finding: The publisher describes full-paper publication as a separate submission followed by double-blind review, with full-paper submissions invited after the conference. A presentation announcement therefore does not establish that a paper was submitted, accepted, or published in these proceedings.

queries: "Detection and Characterization of Microplastics in Mullet Fish" proceedings
"Patrique Erika Cancel" Mugil Maragondon Estuary abstract
retrieval.outcome: The publisher issue page was reviewed directly and lists three articles, none with the CvSU paper title. Exact-title and author searches did not locate a public copy. The ICFA past-abstract-books link redirected to a Microsoft sign-in page and its contents were not reviewed. This bounded search does not establish that no separate abstract or manuscript exists.
limits: The publisher's issue listing is not a complete index of all conference presentations or unpublished abstracts.
The inaccessible abstract-book link was not treated as evidence that the paper is absent.
The CvSU newsletter is a secondary announcement; the underlying study and its taxa/sample records were not independently inspected.
Do not equate conference presentation with peer-reviewed publication or occurrence-level evidence.

rightsReview.decision: Retain only an attributed bibliography and retrieval result. Do not copy microplastic findings, an image, paper text, or data into Bangwit until the underlying study and reuse terms are verified.

nextAction: If further resolution is needed, request the presentation abstract or full paper from an authorized CvSU or author route only with separate approval. Continue public retrieval for the unidentified Bacoor fish-tissue study and the final Imus River watershed vulnerability/pollution deliverable without conflating them with this Maragondon Estuary lead.
